Owner/Operator of Vessel: Clean Products Tankers Alliance (CPTA) / PRODUCTS TANKERS MANAGEMENT COMPANY INC
Explanation of National Defense Interest:
The vessel, Seaways Kolberg was identified as carrying off-specification jet fuel upon completion of load, which rendered the cargo unsuitable for delivery to its intended recipient. As a result, alternative disposition options were urgently evaluated.
At the time of discovery, the only readily available option was to discharge the cargo back into the original shore tank at Baytown Refinery. However, this action would have contaminated the remaining on-specification product within the tank, significantly reducing available supply to critical receivers in the region and compromising jet fuel inventory intended for service at the local airport.
In order to prevent disruption of fuel supply to critical consumers, preserve aviation fuel availability, and avoid contamination of otherwise usable inventory, the cargo was sold as a downgraded product to a receiver with sufficient available ullage and the capability to safely accept the off-specification material.
Given the circumstances, the inability to deliver the cargo as originally intended, and the substantial adverse impacts that would have resulted from returning the product to the originating shore tank, we respectfully request consideration of a Jones Act waiver. Granting this waiver would support the continued movement and disposition of the affected cargo in a manner that protects regional fuel supply, minimizes operational disruption, and serves the public interest.
